subject: Remove RDB compatibility test and data (#27)
reason: The change only removes an integration test (test_import_rejson_rdbs), its RDB fixture files and README, and pins the CI runner image from ubuntu-latest to ubuntu-22.04. No module source code is modified, so the built module's behavior (commands, replies, RDB serialization/deserialization) is identical on both builds; there is no changed path for a scenario to reach.
